Auth.loginDescription: Use the owner password configured on the server. IPTV provider login is separate.
Auth.invalidLogin: Incorrect password or too many attempts. Wait and try again.
Auth.pairDescription: This invitation grants read-only catalog and playback access to this server for 14 days. Verify the address before continuing.
Auth.checkAddress: Check this server’s HTTPS address in your browser bar.
Auth.invalidInvite: Invalid, used or expired invitation. Ask the owner for a new QR.
Auth.shareDescription: Use this invitation to watch the same catalog on another device: create the QR and open it there. This grants viewing access, not source editing, and never sends provider credentials.
Auth.passwordRequired: To create an invitation, configure MOSA_ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 16 characters) and restart Mosa. The installation ID does not grant access.
Auth.httpsRequired: For another device to scan the QR, set MOSA_PUBLIC_ORIGIN and a genuinely reachable protected HTTPS proxy. Setting the variable alone does not make the server reachable.
Auth.inviteWarning: Anyone holding this QR before expiry can use it once. Share only with someone you trust. Your provider may restrict multi-device use.
